purpose: Teach: ぶろ/リーチ/ジーニョ/レナ/ヤス/キラー/ドタバタ/バーン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「ぶろの世界を覗いてみたい」と仰った
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, your father once said he wanted to peek into the world of professional sumo.
lines.style: Soft, reflective opening. Gentle nostalgia in the pacing. Slight wistfulness coloring each clause. Trailing off slightly at the end, as if returning from memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、麻雀でリーチをよく掛けられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and dear, when you were young, you used to call mahjong reaches so often, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, teasing affection. Quick, playful delivery on the question. The lilt of someone gently reminding her husband of his own forgotten joys. Light and intimate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがブラジルのロナウジーニョのプレーに感動された
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, your father was so moved by Ronaldinho's playing in Brazil.
lines.style: Slower pace on this memory. Respectful tone — honoring his father-in-law's passion. Slight pause before Ronaldinho's name, as if seeing it unfold again. Warm recognition.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、姪のレナちゃんを可愛がられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa — when you were young, you did dote on your niece Lena, didn't you?
lines.style: Knowing smile in the voice. Gentle reminder phrased as affectionate question. The rhythm of someone who knows this will land. Warm, slightly mischievous.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「ヤスい服でも体形次第」と仰った
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, your father used to say, "It doesn't matter how cheap the clothes are — it's all about how they fit your frame."
lines.style: Quotation marked by slight shift in register. Respectful tone honoring the father's wisdom. Steady delivery, as if these words still resonate. Trailing off gently after the thought.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、サッカーのキラーパスを評論されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa — when you were young, you used to critique soccer passes like nobody else, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, slightly teasing. Quick tempo on the setup. Affectionate lilt on the question tag. The rhythm of long-married recognition — she knows this about him, and delights in reminding him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがドタバタコメディ映画を毎週観られた
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, your father watched slapstick comedy films every single week.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wry amusement in the delivery. Steady pacing. The small smile of someone sharing a beloved quirk. Slight warmth and acceptance in each word.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、花火大会の「バーン」という音を愛されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa — when you were young, you loved that big 'boom' sound at the fireworks festival, didn't you?
lines.style: Close, intimate delivery — as if sharing a secret they've kept for decades. Warm smile audible. The word 'boom' given small, genuine weight. Trailing off with tender recognition.
